title: Pokémon TCG Mimikyu Stamped Trick or Trade 2023 097/193 Regular Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Mimikyu card is the perfect addition to any Pokémon TCG collection. With its unique character and basic stage, this card is sure to impress both avid collectors and casual players alike. The card is part of the Trick or Trade Booster Bundle 2023 set and has a card number of 097/193.

The Mimikyu card features a regular finish and is a regular rare card. It is a Pokémon type card and is manufactured in 2023. Whether you're looking to complete your collection or just add to it, this card is the perfect choice. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and exciting card.
